Disclosure deferral simulator

Celine (S8) is under investigation; Marc (S11) is a control person who gets the same ordinary lookups; Lena (S12) co-owns Celine's car. Add lookups, request and approve a deferral, move the clock, and compare what each citizen sees. While the investigation is protected, Celine's log must be identical to Marc's.

What this console tests: the rules and behaviour specified in the TRUSTLINE build pack, using a reference model written in this file. It does not test the Rust build, which does not exist yet; once Claude Code builds it, the same scenarios run against the real code (the acceptance criteria in spec/registry.yaml). The access policy here mirrors policies/trustline.cedar; the disclosure logic mirrors citizen.visible_access_events in db/schema.sql. Concept by Limah Innovations, Corp.; not an official system of the Government of Saint Lucia. All people, identifiers and records are synthetic.
